coverage.definition: Analysis v1 starts at migration; first observed qualifying activity is not installation or a new account. No historical dimensions are reconstructed.
coverage.cohort_scope: First-observation build/platform and selected population; mode filters activity only.
coverage.foreground: Sum of client-reported foreground intervals; missing final intervals and concurrent devices affect coverage.
coverage.retention: Exact UTC D1/D7/D30, any return build; follow-up is provisional for seven additional days.
coverage.totals: Full filtered SQL aggregates; detail option limits do not truncate metrics

finance.coverage: Money is grouped by currency, provider and accounting basis. Verified purchases prove fulfilment, not monetary revenue. AdMob amounts are estimated network earnings in provider calendar dates (America/Los_Angeles); not player LTV. Opening Coin balances are not earnings.
